question: How should the faultless goddess be contemplated after she has returned to her own city?
premises: The goddess has gone to her own city
The practitioner has beheld her there
She is faultless in her qualities
inference: After beholding her return to her own city, the practitioner should meditate on the faultless goddess endowed with excellent qualities
plain_english: Having beheld the goddess gone to her own city, one should meditate on her as faultless in her qualities.
